official_documents.finding: The current MBS XML specification defines DD.MM.YYYY for date fields including BenefitStartDate and FeeStartDate.
The page documents XML, book, Word/PDF, and text download resources but does not document the date convention of the distinct legacy Group P7 workbook.

next_evidence: Obtain source-specific documentation or source-owner confirmation that applies to the exact legacy P7 workbook before selecting a conversion profile.
boundary: The XML specification cannot be transferred to a separate workbook era. This documentation review makes no workbook date-semantic claim and does not authorize conversion, derived admission, or publication.
